## Motivation

- At serving shapes (8 or 16 heads per rank, M = batch or 6 x batch) these launches are short and under-filled.
- This PR rewrites all three in Gluon for gfx950 and tunes the launch configuration per M range, lowering per-launch overhead and kernel time.
- Result: per-layer core 1.13-1.35x faster; end-to-end interactivity p50 +5.2-6.6% at TP8 and TP4/EP4; GSM8K and MTP accept length unchanged.

## Modifications

One commit per kernel:

| kernel | new file | replaces | in |
|---|---|---|---|
| sparse MLA (split-K producer + reduce) | `kernels/ops/attention/dsa/gluon_sparse_mla_decode_gfx950.py` | Triton split-K sparse MLA | `dsa_backend.py`, `"triton"` decode and target verify |
| q absorb + RoPE + KV write (one launch) | `kernels/ops/attention/gluon_mla_absorb_rope_cache_gfx950.py` | aiter `fused_fp8_bmm_rope_cat_and_cache_mla` | `forward_mla_rocm.py`, existing fused path |
| value absorb | `kernels/ops/gemm/gluon_mla_absorb_v_gfx950.py` | aiter fp8 batched GEMM | `forward_mla_rocm.py`, `rocm_absorb_v_bmm` |

- Same inputs and outputs as the calls they replace; KV-cache rows are bitwise equal to aiter's.
- Per-M launch parameters (grid, split count, tile, cache modifiers, kernarg preload) are module constants measured on MI355X.
- Sparse MLA: a generic producer for every M plus specialised producers for 7 verify shapes; at TP8 with M <= 18 the idle half of each 16-row MFMA tile computes the second half of the value dimension.
- No new environment variable, server flag or aiter dependency; the guards read existing settings only.
- Shared code touched: `dsa_backend.py`, `forward_mla_rocm.py`, one line in `deepseek_v2.py` (per-layer flag, False off gfx950). New modules are imported only behind the gfx950 check.

**Guards and coverage**

- All three require gfx950, Gluon with a CTA barrier, `--dsa-decode-backend triton` (the ROCm default), fp8_e4m3 KV, the GLM-5 MLA shape (kv_lora 512, qk_nope 192, rope 64, v_head 256), no DCP, and decode (M = batch) or target verify (M = 6 x batch). Decided at construction, shape check per call.

| kernel | TP8, 8 heads per rank: M (verify batch) | TP4, 16 heads per rank: M (verify batch) | extra conditions |
|---|---|---|---|
| sparse MLA | <= 128 (<= 21) | <= 240 (<= 40) | q already concatenated; KV rows x 576 < 2^32 |
| absorb + RoPE + KV | <= 128 (<= 21) | <= 384 (<= 64) | aiter path on (`SGLANG_USE_AITER=1`); per-tensor fp8 `w_kc`; non-neox rotary |
| value absorb | <= 128 (<= 21) | <= 72 or 97-120 (<= 12 or 17-20) | aiter path on (`SGLANG_USE_AITER=1`); per-tensor fp8 `w_kc` / `w_vc` |

- Ranges are where the Gluon kernels measured faster. Specialised sparse-MLA producers: TP8 M = 6, 12, 18, 30; TP4 M = 6, 36, 42.
- Covers the InferenceX GLM-5.2 MI355X agentic sweep (TP8 conc 1-4, TP4/EP4 conc 4-16, batch <= 2 x conc); the value absorb covers only part of the TP4 range.
- Everything else (larger batches, prefill, draft extend, any CUDA build) runs the existing kernels unchanged.

**Models**

- Matches the `glm_moe_dsa` family (GLM-5, 5.1, 5.2, 5.3); validated on GLM-5.2-MXFP4 only.
- Unaffected: GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V3.x, Kimi, and servers using `--dsa-decode-backend tilelang` or `aiter`.

**Compiler notes**

- Value-absorb epilogue reads MFMA results in inline asm, where LLVM inserts no wait states; each variant pads it with `s_nop` to gfx950's 12. Checked in the ISA of all 96 variants on Triton 3.6.0, a 3.7-dev snapshot, ROCm 3.7.0 and 3.8.0.
- Specialised sparse-MLA producers end their softmax stage with a CTA barrier (they raced without it on the 3.7-dev snapshot). Without a Gluon CTA barrier the module is not used.
- Two wrappers set the process-global `knobs.amd.kernarg_preload_max_dwords` under a lock and restore it.

## Accuracy Tests

| test | checks | cases (MI355X) |
|---|---|---|
| `test_gluon_sparse_mla_decode_gfx950.py` | vs fp32 and Triton; graph == eager; repeated runs bitwise; KV-offset edges | 59 pass |
| `test_gluon_mla_absorb_rope_cache_gfx950.py` | KV rows bitwise vs aiter; q vs aiter / fp32; graph == eager | 59 pass |
| `test_gluon_mla_absorb_v_gfx950.py` | vs aiter and fp32; graph == eager; stale MFMA read | 45 pass |
| `test_dsa_gluon_sparse_mla_decode_gate.py` (CPU) | each guard term off; existing kernel outside guard; no CTA barrier | 5 + 13 subtests pass |
| `test_rocm_mla_absorb_fusion_gate.py` (CPU) | each guard term off; existing kernel outside guard | 10 + 18 subtests pass |
| existing `test_triton_sparse_mla_hip.py` | unchanged stock kernel | 8 pass |

- Per-layer core vs fp32: rms_rel 0.034-0.040 (this PR) vs 0.034-0.039 (main), 14 points.
- GSM8K: 1319 questions, 5-shot, TP4/EP4 with the e2e server flags, real MTP drafting.

| | accuracy | invalid | mean accept length |
|---|---|---|---|
| main (merge-base) | 0.929 | 0.001 | 3.89 |
| this PR | 0.932 | 0.000 | 3.87 |

- MI355X, ROCm 7.2, image `lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.22-rocm720-mi35x-20261021` (ROCm Triton `3.7.0+amd.rocm7.2.0.git89002410`), `amd/GLM-5.2-MXFP4`, fp8 KV.
- Installed sglang package replaced by main at the merge-base or by this branch.

### Microbenchmark

- Per-layer `forward_absorb_rocm_core`, 16 real layers in one CUDA graph, L2 flushed per layer, context 128k.
- Idle node, 3 alternating fresh-process rounds, median (spread <= 1.5%); merge-base 38ff13ea79; script on request.

| setup | mode | M | main (us) | this PR (us) | speedup |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| TP8 | decode | 1 | 27.8 | 21.3 | 1.30x |
| TP8 | decode | 8 | 30.8 | 23.9 | 1.29x |
| TP8 | decode | 64 | 55.6 | 45.6 | 1.22x |
| TP8 | verify | 12 | 29.4 | 22.7 | 1.29x |
| TP8 | verify | 48 | 48.8 | 36.2 | 1.35x |
| TP4 | verify | 6 | 32.7 | 26.0 | 1.26x |
| TP4 | verify | 24 | 45.1 | 36.5 | 1.24x |
| TP4 | verify | 96 | 77.5 | 68.5 | 1.13x |
| TP4 | verify | 144 | 103.7 | 81.3 | 1.28x |

- Specialised vs generic sparse-MLA producer: +1.5-12.7% at the shapes kept; TP8 M = 24, 36, 42 gained nothing and were removed.
- Value absorb alone: 1.05x at TP8 verify M = 48, about 1.02x at TP4 verify M = 48 and 120.
- On top of open upstream PRs 44322 / 41003 / 41651 (earlier shared-node runs): still 1.12-1.33x.

- InferenceX agentic-coding trace replay (aiperf) with the recipe's server flags; 1200 s per run; ABBA, 2 runs per arm, whole node, fresh server per run.
- Both arms set `SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_LEN=3.61` as the recipe does (per-step cost; real accept length in the accuracy section).
- Merge-base 611a703061, before the CTA barrier was added (<= 0.3% of a verify cycle).
- Main -> this PR, mean of 2 runs; interactivity in tok/s per user, output and total (input + output) token throughput in tok/s per GPU.

| setup | interactivity p50 | interactivity p90 | output token throughput per GPU | total token throughput per GPU |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| TP8 conc 1 | 302.9 -> 319.1 (+5.3%) | 272.6 -> 287.8 (+5.6%) | 17.19 -> 18.32 (+6.6%) | 2646 -> 2562 (-3.2%) |
| TP8 conc 2 | 297.3 -> 312.6 (+5.2%) | 245.5 -> 259.0 (+5.5%) | 20.85 -> 21.15 (+1.4%) | 2496 -> 2592 (+3.8%) |
| TP8 conc 4 | 286.6 -> 305.6 (+6.6%) | 231.4 -> 236.5 (+2.2%) | 27.77 -> 27.15 (-2.2%) | 3244 -> 3217 (-0.8%) |
| TP4/EP4 conc 4 | 208.2 -> 219.7 (+5.5%) | 161.0 -> 167.2 (+3.8%) | 50.41 -> 51.27 (+1.7%) | 6010 -> 6125 (+1.9%) |

- Per A/B pair: interactivity p50 +3.8..+7.9%, TPOT p50 -3.6..-7.4%, total token throughput -3.2..+7.2%.
- Main vs main (TP8 conc 1 / 2 / 4, TP4/EP4 conc 4): output token throughput 0.2 / 1.0 / 0.4 / 1.5%, total 0.1 / 1.8 / 0.8 / 0.7%.
- Throughput is paced by the trace: it counts the turns that finish in the window, and total is > 99% input tokens.
- TP8 conc 1 total: the branch processed +0.9% input and +11% output tokens, over a 4% longer window (1214 vs 1165 s).
- TP8 conc 4 output: one 15.9k-token turn finished in the window only in the main run. On requests both arms completed, output tok/s is +4.7..+5.4% at every concurrency.
- Predicted TPOT gain (78 layers x microbenchmark saving / main verify cycle): 3.9-5.5%.
- TTFT and end-to-end latency: within run-to-run spread.

- Followed two other upstream changes: sparse-attention outputs are now token-first (`.squeeze(0)`), and the KV buffer is read through `get_kv_layers()`, as the aiter path does.
- The value-absorb commit is unchanged.

Re-tested on the rebased head `8776602aee` (MI355X):

- Kernel tests 59 / 59 / 45 and `test_triton_sparse_mla_hip.py` 16, CPU gate tests and pre-commit all pass.
- Per-layer core speedup vs the new main, previous table in brackets:

| setup | mode | M | speedup |
|---|---|---|---|
| TP8 | decode | 1 / 8 / 64 | 1.31x / 1.29x / 1.22x (1.30 / 1.29 / 1.22) |
| TP8 | verify | 12 / 48 | 1.30x / 1.34x (1.29 / 1.35) |
| TP4 | verify | 6 / 24 / 96 | 1.26x / 1.23x / 1.13x (1.26 / 1.24 / 1.13) |

- Error vs fp32 unchanged: rms_rel 0.036-0.040 (main 0.034-0.039).
- End-to-end and accuracy results above predate the rebase; kernels and guards are unchanged.

python3 -m pytest -q test/registered/kernels/ops/attention/test_gluon_sparse_mla_decode_gfx950.py \
  test/registered/kernels/ops/attention/test_gluon_mla_absorb_rope_cache_gfx950.py \
  test/registered/kernels/ops/gemm/test_gluon_mla_absorb_v_gfx950.py \
  test/registered/kernels/ops/attention/test_triton_sparse_mla_hip.py \
  test/registered/unit/layers/attention/test_dsa_gluon_sparse_mla_decode_gate.py \
  test/registered/unit/models/test_rocm_mla_absorb_fusion_gate.py
# TP4/EP4 server; max-running-requests = cuda-graph-max-bs-decode = 2 x conc (16 for GSM8K)
# TP8: --tp 8 --ep-size 1, no HiCache flags
SGLANG_OPT_USE_TOPK_V2=true python3 -m sglang.launch_server --model-path amd/GLM-5.2-MXFP4 \
  --trust-remote-code --tp 4 --ep-size 4 --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3 \
  --dsa-prefill-backend triton --dsa-decode-backend triton \
  --chunked-prefill-size 32768 --mem-fraction-static 0.85 \
  --max-running-requests 8 --cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 8 \
  --speculative-algorithm EAGLE --speculative-num-steps 5 --speculative-eagle-topk 1 \
  --speculative-num-draft-tokens 6 \
  --enable-hierarchical-cache --hicache-size 180 --hicache-write-policy write_through

- gfx950 only; TP8 and TP4 head counts only; DCP keeps the existing kernels; needs a Gluon CTA barrier (Triton >= 3.6).

- GSM8K at TP4/EP4 only; GLM-5, 5.1, 5.3 not tested.

- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

@@ -0,0 +1,1469 @@
+"""Gluon split-K sparse MLA decode for gfx950 (MI355X), fp8 KV cache.
+
+Replaces the Triton split-K producer + reduce of ``triton_sparse_mla`` for the
+DSA decode / target-verify shapes of GLM-5-class models: 8 or 16 local heads,
+kv_lora_rank 512 + rope 64 (576-byte fp8 rows), top-k 2048.
+
+  q_all:   [M, H, 576] fp8 e4m3 (q_nope | q_rope, one buffer)
+  kv:      [num_slots, 1, 576] fp8 e4m3
+  indices: [M, 2048] int32 KV slots, -1 = empty
+  output:  [1, M, H, 512] bf16
+
+Every M takes one producer launch writing head-major partials
+[M, H, splits, 512] and one reduce launch. Most M use the generic producer;
+the rows in ``_TUNED_ROUTES`` are the verify shapes (M = 6 * batch) with a
+producer specialised for that exact shape.
+"""
+
+import functools
+import math
+
+import torch
+from triton.experimental import gluon
+from triton.experimental.gluon import language as gl
+from triton.experimental.gluon.language.amd import cdna4
+from triton.experimental.gluon.language.amd.cdna4 import async_copy
+
+try:
+    from triton.experimental.gluon.language import barrier as _cta_barrier
+except ImportError:  # Triton 3.6 names it thread_barrier.
+    from triton.experimental.gluon.language import thread_barrier as _cta_barrier
+
+from sglang.srt.utils import get_device_core_count
+
+
+@gluon.jit
+def _gen_offsets(
+    irow,
+    kt,
+    NT: gl.constexpr,
+    BK: gl.constexpr,
+    KV_DIM: gl.constexpr,
+    topk: gl.constexpr,
+    blk: gl.constexpr,
+    blt: gl.constexpr,
+    ms: gl.constexpr,
+):
+    ktc = gl.minimum(kt, NT - 1)
+    base = irow + ktc * BK
+    nK = gl.arange(0, BK, layout=gl.SliceLayout(1, blk))
+    nT = gl.arange(0, BK, layout=gl.SliceLayout(1, blt))
+    nS = gl.arange(0, BK, layout=gl.SliceLayout(0, ms))
+    rk = gl.load(base + nK)
+    rt = gl.load(base + nT)
+    rs = gl.load(base + nS)
+    o_k = gl.maximum(rk, 0).to(gl.uint32) * KV_DIM
+    o_t = gl.maximum(rt, 0).to(gl.uint32) * KV_DIM
+    v = (rs >= 0) & (kt < NT)
+    return (o_k, o_t, v)
+
+
+@gluon.jit
+def _gen_load(
+    kv_ptr,
+    o_k,
+    o_t,
+    D_V: gl.constexpr,
+    D_TAIL: gl.constexpr,
+    blk: gl.constexpr,
+    blt: gl.constexpr,
+):
+    dk = gl.arange(0, D_V, layout=gl.SliceLayout(0, blk))
+    dtt = gl.arange(0, D_TAIL, layout=gl.SliceLayout(0, blt))
+    kv = gl.load(kv_ptr + o_k[:, None] + dk[None, :], cache_modifier=".cg")
+    kt_ = gl.load(kv_ptr + o_t[:, None] + (D_V + dtt)[None, :], cache_modifier=".cg")
+    return (kv, kt_)
+
+
+@gluon.jit
+def _gen_step(
+    q,
+    qt,
+    skv,
+    skt,
+    vv,
+    m_i,
+    l_i,
+    acc,
+    qk_scale,
+    lg_fp8,
+    BH: gl.constexpr,
+    BK: gl.constexpr,
+    mt: gl.constexpr,
+    ms: gl.constexpr,
+    mp: gl.constexpr,
+    bt: gl.constexpr,
+    ap: gl.constexpr,
+    bp: gl.constexpr,
+):
+    NEG: gl.constexpr = -3.4028234663852886e38
+    sc = gl.zeros([BH, BK], gl.float32, layout=mt)
+    sc = cdna4.mfma(q, skv.permute((1, 0)).load(bt), sc)
+    sc = cdna4.mfma(qt, skt.permute((1, 0)).load(bt), sc)
+    sc = gl.convert_layout(sc, ms)
+    sc = gl.where(vv[None, :], sc * qk_scale, NEG)
+    m_new = gl.maximum(m_i, gl.max(sc, axis=1))
+    p = gl.exp2(sc - (m_new - lg_fp8)[:, None])
+    pd = gl.convert_layout(p.to(gl.float8e4nv), ap)
+    alpha = gl.exp2(m_i - m_new)
+    l_i = l_i * alpha + gl.sum(p, axis=1)
+    alpha_p = gl.convert_layout(alpha, gl.SliceLayout(1, mp))
+    acc = cdna4.mfma(pd, skv.load(bp), acc * alpha_p[:, None])
+    return (m_new, l_i, acc)
+
+
+# Generic producer: one CTA per (row, split) walks tps BK-key tiles; partials are
+# head-major [M, H, ks, D_V] (bf16) plus lse [M, H, ks] (log2 domain).
+@gluon.jit(do_not_specialize=["ks", "tps"])
+def _sparse_mla_split_k_gen_kernel(
+    q_ptr,
+    qr_ptr,
+    kv_ptr,
+    idx_ptr,
+    lse_ptr,
+    acc_ptr,
+    qk_scale,
+    lg_fp8,
+    ks,
+    tps,
+    topk: gl.constexpr,
+    H: gl.constexpr,
+    KV_DIM: gl.constexpr,
+    D_V: gl.constexpr,
+    D_TAIL: gl.constexpr,
+    BH: gl.constexpr,
+    BK: gl.constexpr,
+    NT: gl.constexpr,
+    STRIDE_QN_T: gl.constexpr,
+    STRIDE_QN_H: gl.constexpr,
+    STRIDE_QR_T: gl.constexpr,
+    STRIDE_QR_H: gl.constexpr,
+    PST_CM: gl.constexpr,
+):
+    t = gl.program_id(0)
+    pk = gl.program_id(2)
+    mt: gl.constexpr = gl.amd.AMDMFMALayout(4, [16, 16, 32], True, [1, 4])
+    ms: gl.constexpr = gl.amd.AMDMFMALayout(4, [16, 16, 32], True, [4, 1])
+    mp: gl.constexpr = gl.amd.AMDMFMALayout(4, [16, 16, 32], True, [1, 4])
+    at: gl.constexpr = gl.DotOperandLayout(0, mt, 8)
+    bt: gl.constexpr = gl.DotOperandLayout(1, mt, 8)
+    ap: gl.constexpr = gl.DotOperandLayout(0, mp, 8)
+    bp: gl.constexpr = gl.DotOperandLayout(1, mp, 8)
+    blk: gl.constexpr = gl.BlockedLayout([1, 16], [2, 32], [4, 1], [1, 0])
+    blt: gl.constexpr = gl.BlockedLayout([1, 16], [16, 4], [4, 1], [1, 0])
+    shk: gl.constexpr = gl.SwizzledSharedLayout(16, 1, 16, [1, 0])
+    sht: gl.constexpr = gl.SwizzledSharedLayout(8, 4, 4, [1, 0])
+    NEG: gl.constexpr = -3.4028234663852886e38
+    irow = idx_ptr + t * topk
+    kt0 = pk * tps
+    (o_k0, o_t0, v0) = _gen_offsets(irow, kt0, NT, BK, KV_DIM, topk, blk, blt, ms)
+    (kvA, ktA) = _gen_load(kv_ptr, o_k0, o_t0, D_V, D_TAIL, blk, blt)
+    vA = v0
+    dk = gl.arange(0, D_V, layout=gl.SliceLayout(0, blk))
+    hr = gl.minimum(gl.arange(0, BH, layout=gl.SliceLayout(1, at)), H - 1)
+    dtq = gl.arange(0, D_TAIL, layout=gl.SliceLayout(0, at))
+    qt = gl.load(qr_ptr + t * STRIDE_QR_T + hr[:, None] * STRIDE_QR_H + dtq[None, :])
+    hb = gl.minimum(gl.arange(0, BH, layout=gl.SliceLayout(1, blk)), H - 1)
+    qb = gl.load(q_ptr + t * STRIDE_QN_T + hb[:, None] * STRIDE_QN_H + dk[None, :])
+    q = gl.convert_layout(qb, at)
+    skv = gl.allocate_shared_memory(kvA.dtype, [BK, D_V], shk)
+    skt = gl.allocate_shared_memory(kvA.dtype, [BK, D_TAIL], sht)
+    m_i = gl.full([BH], -1e30, gl.float32, layout=gl.SliceLayout(1, ms))
+    l_i = gl.zeros([BH], gl.float32, layout=gl.SliceLayout(1, ms))
+    acc = gl.zeros([BH, D_V], gl.float32, layout=mp)
+    for i in range(0, tps - 1):
+        vv = vA
+        skv.store(kvA)
+        skt.store(ktA)
+        (o_kn, o_tn, vA) = _gen_offsets(
+            irow, kt0 + i + 1, NT, BK, KV_DIM, topk, blk, blt, ms
+        )
+        (kvA, ktA) = _gen_load(kv_ptr, o_kn, o_tn, D_V, D_TAIL, blk, blt)
+        (m_i, l_i, acc) = _gen_step(
+            q,
+            qt,
+            skv,
+            skt,
+            vv,
+            m_i,
+            l_i,
+            acc,
+            qk_scale,
+            lg_fp8,
+            BH,
+            BK,
+            mt,
+            ms,
+            mp,
+            bt,
+            ap,
+            bp,
+        )
+    skv.store(kvA)
+    skt.store(ktA)
+    (m_i, l_i, acc) = _gen_step(
+        q,
+        qt,
+        skv,
+        skt,
+        vA,
+        m_i,
+        l_i,
+        acc,
+        qk_scale,
+        lg_fp8,
+        BH,
+        BK,
+        mt,
+        ms,
+        mp,
+        bt,
+        ap,
+        bp,
+    )
+    den = gl.maximum(l_i, 1e-30)
+    hd = l_i > 0.0
+    inv = gl.convert_layout(gl.where(hd, 1.0 / den, 0.0), gl.SliceLayout(1, mp))
+    acc = acc * inv[:, None]
+    lse = gl.where(hd, gl.log2(l_i) - lg_fp8 + m_i, NEG)
+    ho = gl.arange(0, BH, layout=gl.SliceLayout(1, ms))
+    lse_off = (t * (H * ks) + ho * ks + pk).to(gl.int32)
+    cdna4.buffer_store(lse, lse_ptr, lse_off, mask=ho < H)
+    bso: gl.constexpr = gl.BlockedLayout([1, 8], [2, 32], [4, 1], [1, 0])
+    accb = gl.convert_layout(acc.to(gl.bfloat16), bso)
+    hs = gl.arange(0, BH, layout=gl.SliceLayout(1, bso))
+    ds = gl.arange(0, D_V, layout=gl.SliceLayout(0, bso))
+    so = (t * (H * ks * D_V) + hs[:, None] * (ks * D_V) + pk * D_V + ds[None, :]).to(
+        gl.int32
+    )
+    cdna4.buffer_store(accb, acc_ptr, so, mask=(hs < H)[:, None], cache=PST_CM)
+
+
+# Merges the ks splits of the generic producer; SP is the padded split extent.
+@gluon.jit(do_not_specialize=["ks"])
+def _sparse_mla_reduce_gen_kernel(
+    lse_ptr,
+    acc_ptr,
+    out_ptr,
+    ks,
+    H: gl.constexpr,
+    D_V: gl.constexpr,
+    SP: gl.constexpr,
+    TK: gl.constexpr,
+    VEC: gl.constexpr,
+    NW: gl.constexpr,
+):
+    DC: gl.constexpr = VEC * (64 // TK) * NW
+    t = gl.program_id(0)
+    h = gl.program_id(1)
+    dc = gl.program_id(2)
+    la: gl.constexpr = gl.BlockedLayout(
+        [SP // TK, VEC], [TK, 64 // TK], [1, NW], [1, 0]
+    )
+    base = t * (H * ks) + h * ks
+    kr = gl.arange(0, SP, layout=gl.SliceLayout(1, la))
+    dd = dc * DC + gl.arange(0, DC, layout=gl.SliceLayout(0, la))
+    a_off = (base * D_V + kr[:, None] * D_V + dd[None, :]).to(gl.int32)
+    l_off = (base + kr).to(gl.int32)
+    km = kr < ks
+    a_p = cdna4.buffer_load(acc_ptr, a_off, mask=km[:, None], other=0.0, cache=".cg")
+    lse_r = cdna4.buffer_load(lse_ptr, l_off, mask=km, other=-3.4e38)
+    lse_max = gl.max(lse_r, axis=0)
+    w_r = gl.exp2(lse_r - lse_max)
+    num = gl.sum(a_p.to(gl.float32) * w_r[:, None], axis=0)
+    den = gl.sum(w_r, axis=0)
+    o = num * (1.0 / gl.maximum(den, 1e-30))
+    o_off = (t * (H * D_V) + h * D_V + dd).to(gl.int32)
+    cdna4.buffer_store(o.to(gl.bfloat16), out_ptr, o_off)
+
+
+# Exact-shape producer for M in {6, 12, 18}: one 2*BK key tile per CTA,
+# QK as a scaled fp8 MFMA, async (LDS-DMA) KV gather; DUP=1 serves 8 heads by
+# duplicating them into the 16-row MFMA tile.
+@gluon.jit
+def _sparse_mla_split_k_ov_kernel(
+    q_ptr,
+    qr_ptr,
+    kv_ptr,
+    idx_ptr,
+    lse_ptr,
+    acc_ptr,
+    qk_scale,
+    lg_fp8,
+    topk: gl.constexpr,
+    H: gl.constexpr,
+    KV_DIM: gl.constexpr,
+    D_V: gl.constexpr,
+    D_TAIL: gl.constexpr,
+    BH: gl.constexpr,
+    BK: gl.constexpr,
+    KV_SPLITS: gl.constexpr,
+    STRIDE_QN_T: gl.constexpr,
+    STRIDE_QN_H: gl.constexpr,
+    STRIDE_QR_T: gl.constexpr,
+    STRIDE_QR_H: gl.constexpr,
+    XCD_REMAP: gl.constexpr,
+    XCD_N: gl.constexpr,
+    XCD_PER: gl.constexpr,
+    EPI: gl.constexpr,
+    DUP: gl.constexpr,
+    OVX: gl.constexpr = 0,
+    OVK: gl.constexpr = 0,
+    PRO: gl.constexpr = 0,
+    PST_CM: gl.constexpr = "",
+):
+    if XCD_REMAP:
+        _lin = gl.program_id(0)
+        _j = _lin % XCD_N * XCD_PER + _lin // XCD_N
+        t = _j // KV_SPLITS
+        pk = _j % KV_SPLITS
+    else:
+        t = gl.program_id(0)
+        pk = gl.program_id(2)
+    BK2: gl.constexpr = 2 * BK
+    if DUP:
+        DC: gl.constexpr = D_V // 4
+    else:
+        DC: gl.constexpr = D_V // 2
+    DH: gl.constexpr = D_V // 2
+    mq: gl.constexpr = gl.amd.AMDMFMALayout(4, [16, 16, 128], True, [1, 4])
+    mt: gl.constexpr = gl.amd.AMDMFMALayout(4, [16, 16, 32], True, [1, 4])
+    ms: gl.constexpr = gl.amd.AMDMFMALayout(4, [16, 16, 32], True, [4, 1])
+    aq: gl.constexpr = gl.DotOperandLayout(0, mq, 16)
+    bq: gl.constexpr = gl.DotOperandLayout(1, mq, 16)
+    at: gl.constexpr = gl.DotOperandLayout(0, mt, 8)
+    bt: gl.constexpr = gl.DotOperandLayout(1, mt, 8)
+    blk: gl.constexpr = gl.BlockedLayout([1, 16], [2, 32], [4, 1], [1, 0])
+    shk: gl.constexpr = gl.SwizzledSharedLayout(16, 1, 16, [1, 0])
